item.description:

item.title: Trump Administration ICE Raids (2025)
item.description:
The Pitch

How it was sold:

  • “We’re removing dangerous criminals”
  • “Protecting American workers”
  • “Securing the border”
  • “Targeting violent gang members”
  • “Making America safe again”

The Reality

What’s actually happening:

The numbers:

  • Over 1,000 ICE arrests per day at peak
  • 65% of detained people have NO criminal convictions
  • 93% have no violent convictions
  • Only 7% of detainees convicted of violent crimes (down from 10% under Biden)
  • 30,000+ students absent from Charlotte schools (20% of enrollment) due to fear
  • At least 22 gun incidents including 9 shootings by federal agents

item.title: Gaza Genocide (2023-Present)
item.description:
The Pitch

How it was sold:

  • “Israel has the right to defend itself”
  • “We’re targeting Hamas, not civilians”
  • “Most moral army in the world”
  • “Human shields” - blaming Hamas for civilian casualties
  • “Proportionate response to October 7th attacks”

The Reality

What’s actually happening:

Death toll (as of December 2025):

  • Over 45,000+ Palestinians killed (confirmed)
  • Actual numbers likely much higher - bodies under rubble, unreported deaths
  • 70% of casualties are women and children
